application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description:
- Construction of a Single-Storey Side Extension to contain Garage and Storage.       
- Installation of a car lift on the front driveway.      
- The areas where the chimneys meet a new roof pitch of proposed extension will be altered. The area with tiles will be removed.
- The posts in gate/fence to driveway, located in visibility splays, will be lowered.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
- The proposed development does not alter the existing access arrangements to the building. Separate access points are proposed, including access to the Garage from the front and to the Storage area from the Garden.
- The width of the proposed extension is less than 50% of the width of the existing house. 
- The proposed Single-Storey Side is subordinate to the host dwelling house. The extension is set back from the front elevation of the existing building. Its roof is set at a low level. The existing front elevation remains strongly dominant over the proposed extension.          
- The extension has been designed to follow the form of the main building, incorporating a small crown roof and roof pitches consistent with the angles of the existing main roof. Low profile rooflights are proposed within the crown roof.                                                                                        
- The external walls will be constructed in red brick to match the existing house. The roof will be finished with red plain tiles to match the existing roof covering. Eaves detailing will replicate the existing eaves design to ensure consistency. Flat part of roof finished with lead, detailed with rolls to provide traditional aesthetic.                                     
- The hinged garage doors will have a traditional appearance, with glazing positioned above the doors. The doors from the storage area to the rear garden, located on the rear elevation, will match the existing garden doors on the rear of the property.                                                               
- The extension will also include a vaulted ceiling internally.                                                                                                                                    
- No changes are proposed to the refuse storage location, and the existing access arrangement will remain unchanged.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
- The mass, bulk, and height of the extension have been kept to a minimum in order to avoid any negative impact on the neighbouring property at No. 25.
